submitted_metadata.title: MakeMarketBench Qwen3 BC checkpoint
submitted_metadata.description:
# MakeMarketBench Qwen3-1.7B behaviour-cloning checkpoint

Private research checkpoint by Nicolas Coquelet. Derivative of Qwen3-1.7B by
the Qwen Team, Alibaba Cloud; original MLX conversion by MLX Community.
The full upstream Apache-2.0 licence is included in LICENSE.txt, retrieved from
https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B/resolve/70d244cc86ccca08cf5af4e1e306ecf908b1ad5e/LICENSE .
No upstream NOTICE file was listed at that revision.

Modifications: LoRA behaviour cloning on original synthetic MakeMarketBench
Bayes-dealer demonstrations, stopped at iteration 300 of the earlier run; then
MLX adapter tensors were transposed into PEFT format by train/export_mlx_adapter.py.
This is the historical baseline, not the later 800-iteration checkpoint.
See export.json for original tensor hash, rank, layers and conversion check.
Only adapters are included; base weights are not redistributed. Equivalent
adapter deltas do not imply equivalent logits across MLX affine and CUDA NF4
quantisation. It is incompatible with Qwen3.5-4B.

Code, historical training logs and limitations:
https://github.com/ncoprod/makemarketbench (private pending owner review).
